name: cdm/base/staticdata/party/Address
description: A class to specify a post or street address.

city.description: The city component of the postal address.

country.description: The ISO 3166 standard code for the country within which the postal address is located.

postalCode.description: The code, required for computerized mail sorting systems, that is allocated to a physical address by a national postal authority.

state.description: A country subdivision used in postal addresses in some countries. For example, US states, Canadian provinces, Swiss cantons, ...

street.description: The set of street and building number information that identifies a postal address within a city.
